questions.prompt: Which overall plan matches the greedy invariant approach for Jump Game?

choices.label: Return false whenever any value is zero.
choices.feedback: A zero can be jumped over or can be the final destination.

choices.label: Extend reach using every array value even if its index is unreachable.
choices.feedback: An inaccessible position cannot help extend the reachable frontier.

choices.label: Scan only as far as the reachable frontier permits. Extend that frontier with each reachable index's jump and reject an unreachable gap.

choices.label: Jump to the farthest immediate landing position at every step.
choices.feedback: A shorter landing can have a much greater future reach.
